effects.label: Negate an attack from an opponent's monster
effects.description: Negate an attack from an opponent's monster.

effects.label: Negate an attack then inflict damage equal to the negated attack points
effects.description: Negate an attack then inflict damage to the opponent's life points equal to the negated attack points.

effects.label: Destroy monsters when opponent normal or special summons
effects.description: When the opponent normal or special summons a monster, select and destroy up to 2 monsters they control, aside from the summoned monster.

effects.label: Destroy a monster when the opponent attacks
effects.description: When the opponent initiated an attack, select and destroy a monster they control, except the attacking monster.

effects.label: Destroy weaker monsters when opponent summons
effects.description: When the opponent summons a monster, destroy other monsters they control that have attack points lower than the summoned monster. If nothing exists, destroy the summoned monster instead.

effects.label: Negate a card effect from the opponent
effects.description: Negate a card effect from the opponent.

effects.label: Negate a card effect then destroy that card
effects.description: Negate a card effect from the opponent then destroy that card.

effects.label: Destroy an opponent's monster when they use a card effect
effects.description: Destroy an opponent's monster when they use a card effect.

effects.label: Negate a summon and return it to hand or deck
effects.description: Negate a summon from the opponent then return it to their hand or deck.

effects.label: Increase a monster's attack or defense when attacked
effects.description: Increase the attack or defense of a monster you control by X when attacked by the opponent.

effects.label: Decrease the attacking monster's attack points
effects.description: When an opponent's monster attacked, decrease the attack points of the attacking monster by X.
